title: Padded element distinctness: eventual N(log log N)^2 full-B2 bound

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. Let L(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee.leading. Let R(n) be the sum of the monomials in guarantee.remainder.terms, each coefficient times n^exponent*(log2 n)^log_exponent*(log2 log2 n)^loglog_exponent; an empty sum is zero. There exists N such that C_B2(f_n)>=L(n)-R(n) for every integer n>=N. All remainder coefficients are the exact declared constants. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"One fixed total language L with slices on all bit lengths N. If N<4 reject. Otherwise choose the largest integer w>=1 with n_w=2*w*2^w<=N, partition the first n_w bits into 2^w consecutive records of 2w bits, and accept iff these records are pairwise distinct; ignore the remaining N-n_w bits. A fixed deterministic polynomial-time pairwise-comparison evaluator decides L. Its NP verifier accepts exactly the empty witness when this evaluator accepts, with witness bound zero.","guarantee":{"kind":"eventual_lower_bound","leading":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"2"}},"remainder":{"kind":"explicit","terms":[]}},"projection":{"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"lane_endpoint"},"theorem":"For this fixed language L in P, there exists N0 such that the minimum full-B2 gate count satisfies C_B2(L_N)>=N*(log2(log2 N))^2 for every integer N>=N0, with coefficient one and empty remainder. Consequently for each real A>0 there exists N_A such that C_B2(L_N)>=A*N for every integer N>=N_A. The supplied proofs establish these statements unconditionally by the distinctness tensor theorem over F_2, a constant-overhead simulation of unrestricted nonuniform Boolean circuits, and padding to all actual input lengths. The source theorem provides an existential fixed sigma>0; no numerical value of sigma is asserted.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v2"}

claims: For every integer q>=2, a full-B2 circuit with s gates computing a Boolean function essential in all q inputs yields an exact trivalent F_2 network for its predicate of volume at most 5*s-2*q+2. This unscored lemma includes arbitrary fan-out, repeated pins, shared subcircuits and free constant substitutions; proof.md Section 3 counts consumers exactly and contracts the terminal output test.
